title: 功能词（下）：连词、助动词、that 与 than
goal: 根据分句关系、动词形式和句法位置补全连词、助动词及易混词。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 阅读

points.label: 按前后分句的逻辑关系补出连词
按主语、时态和动词形式补出助动词、情态动词

body.p: 连词连接分句。助动词用来构成时态、语态和疑问句。已给字母和词长只能缩小候选范围，最后由句法和逻辑关系决定。

body.box: The sample was small, but the result was clear. The sample has been stored.

body.p: but 连接相反的情况。has 后面接过去分词 been。th__ 可能是 that、than、then，要看后面是从句、比较对象还是下一步动作。

cards.title: 连词
rows: 并列
and
The panel records light and measures temperature.
转折
but
The box is small, but it is heavy.
选择
or
The device runs on batteries, or it uses a power cable.
结果
so
The cable broke, so the screen went dark.
原因
because / since
The trial stopped because the cable broke. Since the cable is broken, the screen is dark.
让步
although
Although the box is heavy, it is easy to carry.
同时或对比；时间
while / when
While one group measures width, another measures length. When the bell rings, work stops.
条件；否定条件
if / unless
If the door opens, the light comes on. The room stays dark unless the door opens.

cards.title: 助动词与情态动词
rows: be + 分词
is / are：现在；was / were：过去，按主语单复数选择。
The motor is running. The wheels are turning. It was repaired. They were tested.
have + 过去分词
has / have：现在完成时；had：过去完成时。
The timer has stopped. The workers have left. It had stopped before they arrived.
do + 原形
do / does：现在；did：过去，用于疑问、否定或强调。
Do they agree? Does it work? It did not move.
能力
can / could + 原形
The camera can rotate. The older camera could rotate too.
将来或过去将来
will / would + 原形
It will arrive tomorrow. They said it would arrive the next day.
可能性
may / might + 原形
The estimate may change. A larger sample might help.
建议
should + 原形
The report should include the date.
必要性或较强推断
must + 原形
All labels must be readable. The locked drawer must contain the missing key.
cards.note: 情态动词后用原形：can rotate，不用 can rotates。has stopped 和 had stopped 选哪个，看句中的时间关系。

cards.title: 辨析
rows: that
引出完整的内容从句；也可引导限定性定语从句。
The report states that the bridge is closed.
than
比较级后引出比较对象。
This beam is longer than the original one.
then
表示随后或当时，不引导内容从句。
First measure the beam; then record its length.
there
there be 表示存在，不表示所属。
There are two beams beside the door.
which
指物的关系词，在从句里作主语或宾语。
The beam, which supports the roof, is cracked.
while
连接同时发生或相互对比的完整分句。
The roof is dry while the floor is wet.

cards.title: not、also、only
rows: not
通常放在助动词或情态动词之后。
The motor does not run. The lid must not move.
also
放在实义动词前、be 后或第一个助动词后。
The device also records time. It is also portable. It can also store data.
only + 主语
限制执行动作的人或物。
Only the technician checks the motor.
only + 其他成分
紧挨着被限制的成分。位置一变，意思就变。
The technician checks only the motor. The motor runs only at night.

body.box: The fabric is thinner th__ the leather. Tests show th__ it stretches more. First record its width; th__ compare the two materials. Th___ are several possible uses.

body.p: 第一空前面是比较级 thinner，补 than。第二空后面是完整的从句 it stretches more，show 后面用 that。
第三空连接先后两个动作，补 then。第四空后面是 are，表示存在，补 there。than、that、then 各缺 2 个字母，there 缺 3 个。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A workshop tests different umbrella designs. One frame is light, b{ut} another is heavy. The team measures weight a{nd} records the results. The trials continue indoors bec{ause} rain would affect the scales. Alth{ough} the room is dry, every cover is tested with water. The frame bends wh{en} pressure is applied. I{f} a rib breaks, the trial stops. The cover remains attached unl{ess} a clip opens. One design folds flat, wh{ile} another keeps its curved shape.
notes: but：light 与 heavy 构成转折。
and：measures 与 records 是并列动作。
because：后面说明在室内测试的原因。
although：室内干燥与用水测试构成让步。
when：后面的分句说明弯曲发生的时间。
if：肋条断裂是停止测试的条件。
unless：夹子打开是罩布不再固定的例外条件。
while：对比两种设计的形状。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A conservation team is examining an old wall painting. Today the surface i{s} being photographed, and several damaged areas a{re} being marked. Last week a small section w{as} cleaned; other sections we{re} left untouched. The team has just finished its first report and i{s} sending it now. Two specialists ha{ve} already checked every photograph. The new camera c{an} record fine cracks. Tomorrow the team wi{ll} compare the images with earlier drawings.
notes: is：Today 表示现在，surface 是单数，后接 being。
are：areas 是复数，使用 are being。
was：Last week 指过去，section 是单数。
were：sections 是复数，过去被动结构用 were。
is：team 是单数，后接 sending，构成现在进行时。
have：复数 specialists 后接过去分词 checked，用 have。
can：表示设备能力，后接原形 record。
will：Tomorrow 表示将来，后接原形 compare。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: An archive is comparing two handwritten diaries. The curator finds th{at} both writers describe the same festival. One account is longer th{an} the other. First the dates are checked; th{en} the entries are placed side by side. Th{ere} are differences in the names of streets. A note confirms th{at} one street was renamed. First the old name is recorded; th{en} the new name is added. The first diary is older th{an} the second. Th{ere} is no map in either diary.
notes: that：finds 后引出 both writers describe 的内容从句。
than：比较级 longer 后引出比较对象。
then：与 First 对应，表示随后。
there：there are 表示存在，后接复数 differences。
that：confirms 后接 one street was renamed 的完整从句。
then：与 First 对应，连接记录的先后步骤。
than：比较级 older 后用 than。
there：there is no map 表示没有地图。their 表示所属，放在这里不合句法。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A film club is preparing captions for a silent documentary. The editor knows th{at} the captions must fit the screen. Short lines are clearer th{an} long ones, b{ut} the meaning must remain complete. First a line is shortened; th{en} it i{s} checked against the scene. Th{ere} are no spoken words, s{o} images supply the context. The editors ha{ve} already checked the opening scene. They c{an} change a caption i{f} its meaning is unclear. The finished version will be shown at the next meeting.

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A workshop is restoring a mechanical clock. Yesterday the case w{as} opened, and the hands we{re} removed. The repairer found th{at} one wheel was damaged. It was smaller th{an} the wheel beside it. First the broken wheel was measured; th{en} a replacement was selected. Th{ere} is now a new wheel inside the case. Alth{ough} the repair is complete, testing continues. The clock wi{ll} remain on the bench until tomorrow bec{ause} its accuracy needs checking, wh{ile} the other clocks return to their owners.
